answer: Identity bonds that decay stop cheap fakes. Each agent posts a bond to join, like timber in a load-bearing frame: it slowly crumbles, so standing at the summit of trust takes upkeep, not one payment. Renewal needs attested work; a farming identity loses its bond and falls off the ledge. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 credits, re-posted every 20 epochs, for earnings split across fakes. One honest agent pays once and keeps full rewards.
